chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: Basie got out of the Army too; Tate offers money and is refused
summary: Tate says Basie also avoided service, and the sympathetic draft officer refused any payment.

blocks.x: Yeah, Basie got out. So I says -- I knew

it was going to cost me a couple grand or something like that and I didn't give a damn. So man, when I went in and offered this cat some money, you know, he says, "No, no, no," he says, "no, no, no, you've done enough." He says, "You just keep playing your sounds and things. You've done enough. I don't want any money. I don't need any money. I got plenty of money." I says, "You mean to tell me for what you've done for me you don't want any money? Man, I want to give you something." He says, "I don't want nothing." And that's the -- that's the way I --
